snippet.title: Super Robot Wars Y - Gameplay Trailer | Bandai Namco Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the release gameplay overview trailer for Super Robot Wars Y, developed by Bandai Namco Forge Digitals Inc. Take control of units and pilots from different anime in this grid-based tactial RPG when it comes to PC, Switch, and PS5 on August 28, 2025.
